items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-03-22
items.q: And Pauline and Uncle Buddy was a singer... And my Uncle Buddy, well, he's a minister now. He always said, man, he said, oh, I know I can sing. You know, he'd come and he'd let me hear him sometime.

ctx.x: Here, yeah. But, no, what I was thinking more of, of people like street cryers, people who sang. Did your mother sing while she was?

No. You know what, my mama was, yeah. My mama wasn't much of a singer. My aunt, Pauline was a singer. My aunt, Toot, her other sister. Aunt Toot was a, her name was Nancy. And Pauline and Uncle Buddy was a singer. But my mama was, you know, there was always one in the family that didn't sing to. Well, same way with my family. I have a brother. I have a brother. I have a brother. I have a brother. Not only can't, he can't sing, he can't dance. Louis, Louis can't sing and can't dance. Never could. But my mama,…
Louis, Louis can't sing and can't dance. Never could.
